source_issues.title: Affine composition, multiplication order and expressivity
source_issues.detail: Wx+b is affine rather than strictly linear; with column-vector convention applying A then B gives BA, while source says AB and its worked example says W2W1. Depth factorization can affect optimization; arbitrary-function approximation and added capacity require architecture/width/domain conditions. No general impossibility of every face task for all linear representations is established.

source_issues.title: History, prevalence and universal recommendations
source_issues.detail: Earliest activation/history and modern-model default claims are not verified here. ReLU/GELU/SiLU/LSTM choices depend on architecture and training. Bibliography claim introduced ReLU conflicts with body noting an earlier source. References preserved, not externally researched.

source_issues.title: Local activation derivative is not whole-network gradient
source_issues.detail: Weights/Jacobians, masks and residual paths enter chain rule. Ten sigmoid factors bound only the isolated derivative product; ReLU derivative 1 does not guarantee gradient preservation. Finite centered two-layer sigmoid with weight8 each has input derivative4, not derivative-only .0625. Source diagram numbers lack settings.

source_issues.title: Zero centering and signs
source_issues.detail: Positive activations constrain signs of incoming activation factors for a particular downstream delta; they do not make all network/batch weight gradients universally same-sign. Tanh is a scaled/shifted sigmoid relation, and zero-centered range alone does not guarantee zero-mean batches or eliminate zig-zag optimization.

source_issues.title: Kinks and death definitions
source_issues.detail: ReLU is nondifferentiable at zero; code chooses derivative0. Leaky ReLU with alpha!=1 also has kink0, code chooses alpha. Permanent deadness is stronger than finite samples never firing. Upstream changes or optimizer state may revive units; 10-40% rate depends on setup. Negative-side slope alpha is positive, despite source term table wording small negative gradients.

source_issues.title: GELU probability interpretation and derivative mismatch
source_issues.detail: Phi(x) is standard-normal CDF at x, not an input-dependent arbitrary chance of positive sign without a stated latent-variable interpretation. Forward uses tanh approximation; derivative implements exact x*Phi(x). Centered finite differences over selected points show max discrepancy0.0008674555526377858. GELU(-20) and its derivative(-50) round to zero, so avoids deadness entirely is too strong in finite precision.

source_issues.title: Finite precision and clamp
source_issues.detail: Open mathematical ranges can hit endpoints in floating point: sigmoid(1000)=1, softmax([0,-1000])=[1,0]. Source sigmoid clamps x to +/-500 but derivative ignores clamp: at -600 gives7.124576406741285e-218 instead of derivative of constant clipped branch. No NaN/Inf/empty validation; softmax([]) raises ValueError.

source_issues.title: Softmax scope and missing derivative
source_issues.detail: Softmax is vector-valued, unlike source all-functions scalar wording. No softmax Jacobian/derivative is implemented despite objective including all derivatives. Softmax can be used internally for attention/routing, not universally only output. Probabilities are normalized, not guaranteed calibrated; logits-based losses can require omitting explicit output softmax.

source_issues.title: Gradient scan output and endpoint
source_issues.detail: Original loop samples [-5,4.9] in increments .1, excluding5, and prints aggregate counts rather than per-position histogram. abs(gradient)<.01 is an arbitrary near-zero threshold; equals .01 Leaky derivative classified healthy. Counts are not trained-network neuron death rates.

source_issues.title: Forward magnitude experiment is not gradient measurement
source_issues.detail: Source records only activation magnitudes; each scalar output is replicated into all next inputs, with fresh random unscaled weights and no backprop. Original ReLU becomes0 at layer6, sigmoid ends.662811; these do not establish sigmoid-only vanishing gradients or architecture training properties. The exercise50-layer change was not run.

source_issues.title: Finite dead-neuron detector
source_issues.detail: Original20-neuron/1000-Gaussian-input initialization test yields0 dead and0 rare; no optimization occurs. It measures finite firing frequency, not neuron death during training or for all input distributions.

source_issues.title: Training objective and reporting
source_issues.detail: Backward implements half squared-error gradient, while reported loss is full squared error, differing by constant2. Nine-parameter sigmoid network update checked against half-loss central differences, maxerror1.0137932160425578e-11. Training accuracy is measured online before each update, not frozen-final evaluation; no validation split or multi-seed benchmark. GELU update inherits derivative mismatch.
